01 · From my heart

For You

Happy Birthday, my love ❤️

Every day with you feels like a blessing, but today is even more special because it's the day the most beautiful person in my life was born.

You walked into my life and turned ordinary moments into the most precious memories. Your smile lights up my world, your voice calms my heart, and your love makes my life feel complete.

I'm so grateful for every laugh, every conversation, every little moment we share. You are not just my girlfriend — you are my happiness, my peace, and the most beautiful chapter of my life.

On your special day, I just want you to know that you deserve all the love, joy, and dreams this world can offer. I promise to always stand by you, celebrate you, and cherish you. 💕

Happy Birthday to the girl who makes my heart feel like home. ❤️🎂

— Varun ❤️

05 · The last page

One last
thing...

I thought a letter could say everything. It couldn't. So I made you a little world instead.

A little note, just for you…

I don't know if I'll ever find enough words to explain how much you mean to me, but I hope this little world gave you even a tiny glimpse of it. ❤️

I hope you always remember that you are loved, appreciated, and worth celebrating—not just today, but on all the ordinary days too.

Thank you for being you. For the laughs, the random conversations, the little moments, and all the memories we've made along the way.

I don't know what every tomorrow will look like, but I know I'm grateful that you're a part of my today.

So here's to another year of you, more silly conversations, more calls, more memories, and countless little moments that we'll someday look back on and smile about. 🥀

Happy Birthday, my love. ❤️

Keep smiling. Keep being you.

And whenever you miss me, come back here… this little world will always have a place for you. 🌙

— Varun ❤️
